description: Answers "what is the whole record behind this person": for one wallet, every event the board holds in time order, each with a plain label, the job it belongs to and the receipt that proves it. It lists jobs claimed, proofs handed in and whether each was accepted or not, settlements with their transaction hash, earned credits banked and how each closed, payouts a backer's offer recorded, votes and pledges cast, titles the person declared, proof the wallet decided as an acceptor, and, derived from a settled job, the condition it counts as evidence toward. It composes the records my_work, my_money, my_votes and worker_titles already read and creates no store. Free, keyless, read-only. VEALTH IS AN EXPERIMENT AND THIS IS A READ OF THE RECORD, NOT A VALUATION: pay is proposed unless a record says funded and is paid only on a confirmed settlement, a pledge is intent, earned credit is a receipt and never money, a title is self-declared and unverified, and nothing here says anyone is fit for a job. Any source it cannot read is named under unreadable and its counts read unknown, never zero; a few records have no per-wallet read yet and are named too. Newest first by default; pass order and limit to page. Address only, never a private key.

limit.description: Most rows to return, from 1 to 500. Defaults to 100. The summary always counts the whole record.

order.description: desc (the default) lists the newest events first; asc lists the oldest first.

wallet.description: The 0x address whose record to read. Address only, never a private key.

name: my_ledger
title: A person's whole record, event by event, each with its receipt
